{{Quote|Shell is no one's son. His family was murdered on Alderaan. He was here visiting his grandmother, but the shock of the attack was too much for her and&hellip; He's on his own now.|[[J'er Nahj]] on Shell and his grandmother|<ref name="Rebel Force: Hostage" />}}
'''Shell's grandmother''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], her grandson [[Shell (Alderaanian)|Shell]] paid her a visit when [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. Due to the shock, she later [[Death/Legends|died]], leaving Shell an orphan.<ref name="Rebel Force: Hostage" />
